caption: The video captures a woman in a black sleeveless top, layered skirt, pants and heels, with a red flower in her hair bun. She stands in a bright dance studio before a large mirror wall, facing away from the camera. Her reflection is visible on the right side of the frame. With arms already stretched sideways, she makes small wrist adjustments. She then bends her elbows, drawing her hands inward toward her shoulders. The arms extend outward again with open, spread fingers as her feet widen into a stance. Her torso rotates slowly, revealing more of her left side while the extended arms shift orientation. Both arms fold forward and upward near her chest and face, the mirror image tracking each change in view.
relations: As she bends elbows drawing hands inward, the mirror reflection mirrors this inward arm motion symmetrically.
When arms extend outward with spread fingers, her feet simultaneously widen into a broader stance.
As her torso rotates revealing her left side, the extended arms shift their orientation accordingly.
When both arms fold forward and upward near her chest, the mirror image tracks this change.
